title_en: Samsung Electronics DX Division Recruitment Announcement
summary: Samsung Electronics' DX Division is accepting job applications through its careers website until 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday 15 September. Interested students may also request an online job consultation by 12:00 noon on Monday 14 September and register for the online recruitment briefing on Friday 11 September by 5:00 p.m. on Thursday 10 September.

dates.what: Deadline to request an online job consultation
Online recruitment briefing (2026 Second-Half Samsung Electronics DX Division Live Recruitment Briefing)
Deadline to register in advance for the online recruitment briefing

conditions: The access URL for the online recruitment briefing will be sent only to those who register in advance by the registration deadline.
Applications must be submitted by 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday 15 September.
steps: Review business unit, job and other information at https://www.samsung-dxrecruit.com/.
If you wish to receive an online job consultation, request one at https://www.samsungdxcareertalk.com/Apply?p=JGnEDJ~univ~~univ~5sjdzr8Hd5ffyw==/ by 12:00 noon on Monday 14 September.
If you wish to attend the online recruitment briefing on Friday 11 September, register in advance by 5:00 p.m. on Thursday 10 September; the access URL will be sent to registered participants.
Submit your application for the open recruitment at https://www.samsungcareers.com/hr/?no=23055 by 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday 15 September.
translation:
[Samsung Electronics DX Division] Recruitment Announcement

Application period: until 5:00 p.m., Tuesday 15 September

- How to apply
  · Open recruitment: https://www.samsungcareers.com/hr/?no=23055

- Recruitment information
  · Check business unit and job information and a range of other content
    (https://www.samsung-dxrecruit.com/)
  · Online job consultation: Thursday 10 September to Monday 14 September
    (https://www.samsungdxcareertalk.com/Apply?p=JGnEDJ~univ~~univ~5sjdzr8Hd5ffyw==/ ; request deadline: by 12:00 noon, Monday 14 September)
  · Online recruitment briefing: Friday 11 September, 10:00 a.m. to 6:20 p.m.
    (2026 Second-Half Samsung Electronics DX Division Live Recruitment Briefing; registration deadline: by 5:00 p.m., Thursday 10 September)
    The access URL will be sent to those who have registered in advance.
